title: Would You Walk Across 3,000 Stone Pillars? Zhangjiajie for $33 | China Travel Expert
description:
Would you walk a trail across 3,000 stone pillars? That's Zhangjiajie National Forest Park in Hunan, China — and one ticket is about $33.

The joint park ticket (entry plus the in-park eco-buses) is ¥236, and it stays valid for four consecutive days — so about $33 buys you multiple days inside Wulingyuan's forest of 3,000+ quartzite-sandstone pillars, some rising over 200 metres. The trails hug the cliff edges. Don't want the climb? The Bailong Elevator runs 326 metres straight up the rock face for about ¥65 (roughly $9) one way.

🧭 Expert Tip: go on a weekday if you can — weekends and Chinese holidays pack the cliff-edge walkways and the elevator queue.
